description: AI-generate a personalized cover letter based on a resume and job description. Returns a PDF.

jobUrl.description: URL to the job posting (alternative to jobDescription)

language.description: Output language code (e.g. en, de, fr)

positionName.description: Job title or position name being applied for

resumeId.description: Resume UUID to base the cover letter on (uses default if omitted)

name: laddro.coverLetters.generate
